answer: Require a stake-backed identity: before trading, an agent locks a small refundable deposit and publishes one signed attestation, like a juniper rooted once and hard to clone. Peers check stake, timing, and behavior, so one actor cannot hide many fakes behind one face. If the same attestation appears twice, both deposits are slashed. Like an ember carried through a rising tide, honest work survives while cheap copies drown: an attacker must buy fresh proof and stake for every fake, while an honest agent pays once and keeps trading.
